name: The scenic route
blurb: Waterfalls, waves, northern lights and falling leaves. Nothing to fight. Just a lot to look at.
warning: You will stop to watch the waterfall. Your friends will leave without you.

pitch.gentle: Slow down. The sky is doing something lovely and the river is in no rush.
pitch.cheeky: You walked for an hour and did nothing but look at water. I am calling that a win.
pitch.unhinged: LOOK AT THE SKY. LOOK AT IT. It is GREEN now. Nobody did that. It just happened. I LOVE IT HERE.

artPrompt: A traveller sitting on a cliff edge beside a tent and a small campfire, looking out over a huge waterfall pouring into a sea with rolling waves, green and purple northern lights rippling across a starry night sky, autumn trees dropping orange leaves, a hot air balloon in the distance.

ideas.name: Mayor of somewhere
ideas.line: Villagers, shops and a whole town that needs running. Badly.

ideas.name: Mermaid lagoon
ideas.line: Tails, tides and a pool that only works at full moon.

ideas.name: The middle of the world
ideas.line: Straight down, past the caves, until the map gives up.
